title: Minuet in G major (BWV Anh. 114)
description: The best-known minuet from the Notebook for Anna Magdalena Bach, long attributed to Bach but written by Christian Petzold. A graceful 3/4 dance that teaches scale passages, independent hands and Baroque phrasing.

arrangements.label: Intermediate
arrangements.notes: The complete minuet with both sections written out (16 + 16 bars), keeping the original melody and a two-voice left hand of half and quarter notes.
teachingPoints: Right hand sits in a G position (thumb on G4) for most of the first section; bars 3-4 and 17-19 reach up to G5 with the 5th finger.
Second section (bars 17-24) moves to D major: watch the C-sharps in bars 20-23 and the thumb shifts marked in bar 21.
Practice the left hand alone: half note plus quarter in each bar, with the three-quarter-note walk in bar 7 and the descending B-A-G in bar 27.
Keep the dance feel: light on beats 2 and 3, a gentle lift before each new phrase (bars 8, 16, 24, 32).
